text:
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout for release/2026.03.15 -> inference-api (5% traffic). ci: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345 :rocket:

incident-bot: page @oncall - elevated error rate detected during canary (5xx spike). Incident created: INC-20260315-004

ara (SRE): seeing a bunch of 502s from the canary. Logs show KMS decrypt failures for the service role.

liz (engineer): confirmed in logs:
```
ERROR com.redwood.inference.Decryptor - AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111222333:assumed-role/inference-canary-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-ef12-3456
```

tyler (oncall): ack, I'm looking. Did the deploy include a key rotation?

patrick (deploy): yes, infra ran a KMS key rotation earlier in the pipeline for the new env. We updated key alias but I don't think the canary IAM role has the new key policy attached. Rolling back rotation now?

ara (SRE): impact: ~3% of overall requests hitting canary are 502/503. Non-canary traffic unaffected. Customers hitting that canary bucket see failures on long-running completion requests.

customer-success-ash: a handful of customers reported increased errors on inference calls. I've opened CS tickets and set customer-facing status to "degraded". Keeping them updated.

tyler (oncall): can we kill the canary flag quickly? If we toggle the release to 0% it should route all traffic off canary.

patrick (deploy): issuing canary abort and force rollout rollback. Running:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/inference-api --to-revision=42  # revert to last known good
```

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for inference-api -> target revision 42. Status: in progress.

infra-jordan: quick note — the new key's policy was narrower (only prod EC2 roles) and our canary uses an assumed role not included. We need to add the canary role ARN to the key policy or update the role to allow kms:Decrypt.

liz (engineer): trying a manual temporary mitigation: add a short-term inline policy to inference-canary-role allowing kms:Decrypt on the new key. Posting command:
```
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name inference-canary-role --policy-name TempKMSDecrypt --policy-document '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-ef12-3456"}]}'
```

ara (SRE): careful with IAM hotfixes but ok for immediate mitigation if we remove after. Any objections?

tyler (oncall): do it, but also make sure we notify security.

customer-success-ash: after rollback some customers still see retries failing; CS will resend guidance and ask them to retry after ~2 mins.

deploy-bot: rollback completed. Pods are back to stable revision 42. Health checks passing.

ara (SRE): monitoring: error rate back down to baseline. Canary traffic disabled.

oncall-jen: I'm on a handover in 10m. tyler, can you take the postmortem ownership? I'll summarize in #incidents and update the rotation.

tyler (oncall): taking postmortem. action items so far:
- revert temporary inline policy (liz/infra)
- update KMS key policy to include canary role (infra-jordan)
- add automated canary decryption test in CI (eng+infra)
- add a presubmit check: if deploy rotates keys, ensure key policy covers service roles used by canary and canary test runs decrypt check (devex)
- customer communication follow-up (CS)

infra-jordan: I'll open infra PR to add the canary role and update terraform to manage the key policy. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/789

liz (engineer): reverting the temp policy now. running `aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name inference-canary-role --policy-name TempKMSDecrypt`.

ara (SRE): confirm deletion?

liz (engineer): deleted.

tyler (oncall): verifying decrypt works against stable revision (shouldn't need to). All green.

customer-success-ash: marking affected customers as "mitigated" in tracker. Will follow up with postmortem summary and ETA for permanent fix.

tyler (oncall): postmortem will include timeline, cause (key rotation + key policy omission), remediation, and a runbook change: add a pre-rollout KMS policy validation step and an on-deploy kill-switch playbook.

deploy-bot: incident INC-20260315-004 status: resolved -> monitoring.

oncall-jen: handing off to night oncall tyler. I'll leave a short note in the rotation thread.

tyler (oncall): ack handoff. I'll create the incident doc and link PRs and CS tickets.

ara (SRE): thanks everyone. quick retrospective: this was low blast radius but highlights need for KMS-aware canary checks.

patrick (deploy): will add a rollout gate that runs a small decrypt test against the actual canary role and key before shifting traffic.

incident-bot: closing page for INC-20260315-004 (duration ~11 minutes). :white_check_mark:
